services.name: Boat Cruises
services.desc: À La Vie (Salute to Life) is a luxurious Princecraft 24 foot long pontoon boat equipped with cozy & comfortable cushioned seats and powered by a quiet eco-friendly four stroke 115HP outboard Mercury engine. The boat is perfect for cruising and can entertain up to 12 guests and Captain. St-Cyrly yours cruises are a great way to spend an afternoon or a day on the magnificent waters of Okanagan Lake sightseeing while listening to relaxing music. Enjoy a romantic evening, cozy up in our comfortable seats and cuddle under a warm blanket. Take in the breathtaking waterfront homes from secluded cottages to grand estates while enjoying refreshments served to you by the crew. We Supply ... We supply
